info.description: Aion Labs API model released on 2026-09-23, with reasoning. The models page lists a 256K context, a 32K maximum output, and prices of $0.70 per 1M input tokens, $0.18 per 1M cached input tokens, and $1.40 per 1M output tokens. The public models endpoint gives context_length 262144 and max_completion_tokens 32768. The API id is aion-labs/aion-3.5-mini. The documented host is https://api.aionlabs.ai; the page shows the models list and does not print a chat path or a cache-write price.

zh.description: Aion Labs API 模型，2026-09-23 发布，支持推理。模型页列出 256K 上下文、32K 最大输出，价格为输入每百万 tokens 0.70 美元、缓存输入 0.18 美元、输出 1.40 美元。公开的模型列表接口给出 context_length 262144、max_completion_tokens 32768。API id 为 aion-labs/aion-3.5-mini。文档给出的主机是 https://api.aionlabs.ai；页面展示了模型列表，没有写出聊天路径或缓存写入价。
